page.content:
Rev Roadages is a character in Cars 3. He is a stock-car racer who raced for Vinyl Toupee. He later retired from the Piston Cup, and got replaced by Will Rusch.

page.overview:
Who is Rev Roadages?

Rev Roadages is a character in Cars 3. He is a stock-car racer who raced for Vinyl Toupee. He later retired from the Piston Cup, and got replaced by Will Rusch.
